dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: Care to buy some fresh fish? However you cook it, there's no better dish to complement your wine!

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: We sell seafood caught fresh every day, so you never have to worry about quality.

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: I'm a self-employed fishmonger. Running a small business means selling more for less.

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: It's all about making the most of local resources.

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: Getting fresh seafood and seagrass daily from the sea doesn't just fill our bellies, it keeps my family afloat, too.

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: I can live a free life, and it's all thanks to the bounty of the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Pam
dialogues.text: Take care. Remember to come back if you're ever looking to buy fresh seafood!
